threadDescriptions.first-note-flow: Test and improve the first-note onboarding screens in the fictional Fieldmark app.
threadDescriptions.activation-events: Define and validate analytics for onboarding completion and first successful note.
threadDescriptions.offline-save: Fix lost notes when the Fieldmark app starts without a network connection.
threadDescriptions.wedding-flowers: Arrange flowers and vase return for a family wedding.

items.text: Fieldmark first-run sketch: ask walkers to name a place, then write their first trail note. Test whether the blank map before that step is making people quit.
items.rationale: Defines onboarding design hypothesis.

items.text: Flowers for Asha's wedding: mixed white stems in low bowls, six tables. Florist needs final table count by the 9th.
items.rationale: Starts unrelated family-event procurement.

items.text: 'Skip fires twice' on a note beside the laptop. No screen or event name recorded.
items.rationale: Ambiguous between interaction and measurement issues without app context.

items.text: Fieldmark analytics draft: onboarding_done fires on leaving the last intro card, first_note_saved only after storage confirms success. Need a separate skipped flag.
items.rationale: Defines distinct measurement semantics.

items.text: Onboarding experiment handoff: variant Cedar removes the blank map and opens the first-note editor immediately. Add intro_variant=Cedar to onboarding_done and first_note_saved, then verify both events after a complete first-run walkthrough. The design test still compares the same task: creating a trail note.
items.rationale: Specifies UI variant and concrete analytics instrumentation/verification.

items.text: Airplane-mode recording: Fieldmark shows 'saved' for a first trail note, but reopening loses it. Reproduces with a fresh install and no network.
items.rationale: Defines offline persistence defect.

items.text: Florist sketch uses tall vases, but Asha asked for low bowls so guests can see across tables. Request corrected proposal.
items.rationale: Corrects wedding floral design.

items.text: Cedar first-run test with five volunteers: four reached the editor without help; one looked for an account button. Keep the name-place prompt but explain saving before sign-in.
items.rationale: Reports usability results for onboarding variant.

items.text: Event trace on fresh install: onboarding_done emitted twice when app returns from background on the last card. Deduplicate by completed onboarding session, not by screen view.
items.rationale: Identifies and plans analytics duplicate fix.

items.text: Offline save diagnosis: first launch creates the local store only after a profile fetch. Initialize the store before any network work so the editor can commit without a profile.
items.rationale: Explains persistence cause and fix approach.

items.text: Maybe the local one? recording cuts off immediately.
items.rationale: Insufficient referent despite plausible app vocabulary.

items.text: Wedding table count is seven now, not six. Florist can add one matching low bowl; keep the aisle flowers unchanged.
items.rationale: Revises floral quantity.

items.text: Measurement correction: onboarding_done must fire on explicit Finish or Skip, not any exit from the last card; backgrounding is neither. Keep first_note_saved tied to the storage confirmation as before.
items.rationale: Corrects initial completion event rule while preserving save definition.

items.text: Offline fix test: three notes survive force-close in airplane mode on a fresh install. Reconnection later uploads each once; the local store initializes without a profile.
items.rationale: Verifies persistence fix and upload behavior.

items.text: Cedar copy change: 'Your note stays on this device until you sign in.' Put this under the first-note editor, above the save button; next test should check what users think happens offline.
items.rationale: Develops and schedules test of onboarding explanatory copy.

items.text: Release walkthrough for Fieldmark: with the offline-store fix, first_note_saved arrives only after the local commit even without a connection. Test analytics queue replay on reconnect and assert one saved event for the one surviving note; retain the airplane-mode persistence check in the bug's acceptance notes.
items.rationale: Verifies telemetry behavior and offline bug acceptance together.

items.text: Cedar follow-up: all six participants could explain device-only saving after reading the new sentence. Four created a note; two deliberately skipped. Summarize the comprehension finding alongside the task completion counts.
items.rationale: Reports onboarding experiment outcomes.

items.text: Florist revised order accepted: seven low bowls, unchanged aisle stems. Cousin Dan will return the bowls on Monday; add his name to the rental pickup sheet.
items.rationale: Finalizes floral order and rental logistics.

items.text: End of debug log only: 'ok 1 queued 1'. Device and action missing.
items.rationale: Log fragment lacks enough context for analytics or persistence membership.

items.text: Analytics validation complete: Finish and Skip each emit one completion with correct skipped value; returning from background emits none. Saved-note event waits for successful local commit.
items.rationale: Checks corrected event contract.

undo.reason: Hypothetical correction: explanatory screen copy tests user understanding and does not repair or verify persistence.
